messages:
olivia (People Ops): Quick request  hiring ops wants a tiny, copy-pasteable 90-day success pack (offer + onboarding + manager lines). Keep it ultra-compact. Can anyone post a version we can drop into offer emails?

rahul (Recruiter): Need one that fits in the offer note under 'Success in 90 days'  two to three lines max. Also a one-line calendar blurb for 30/60/90 reviews.

lee (Eng Manager): Pasting the minimal set I use. Two variants: IC and Manager prompts. All plain text so hiring ops can paste.

lee (Eng Manager): ```
IC 90-day 'success' (one-liners for offer)
- Engineering: 'Ship a production-quality change to [service] that improves latency/reliability and is covered by tests and monitoring.'
- Product: 'Deliver the MVP of [feature] that validates the core hypothesis with user feedback and a defined success metric.'

Manager quick checklist (30/60/90 invites & prep)
- 30-day invite line: '30m check-in  unblock ramp, confirm priorities, and agree on first deliverable.'
- 60-day invite line: '45m review  demo progress, collaboration feedback, and mid-course adjustments.'
- 90-day invite line: '60m checkpoint  summarize outcomes, set Q2 goals, and discuss growth steps.'

Manager prompts to use in 1:1s
- Week 2: 'What felt most confusing? What do you need to move faster?'
- Month 1: 'Show me one thing you're proud of and one thing blocking you.'
- Month 2: 'Which stakeholder relationships need attention? Where can I help?'
- Month 3: 'What outcomes would you call a success for the next 90 days?'

Self-review micro-prompts (30/60/90)
- 'I took ownership of [area], shipped X, and validated Y metric/user signal.'
- 'I improved onboarding for myself and others by pairing and documenting Z.'
- 'I raised and prioritized a risk and reduced time-to-recover by N%.'
```

sam (Software Eng): Love the short self-review lines. For engineers add a single ops bullet: 'Participated in on-call runbook and reproduced an incident locally.'

nina (Product): For product hires swap 'PR' language to 'spec' and add 'ran 3 user interviews' as a concrete month-2 check.

olivia (People Ops): Can you make a 2-line offer sentence variant that hiring ops can paste straight into emails?

lee (Eng Manager): Yep  two variants below (copy-ready).

lee (Eng Manager): ```
Offer sentence (Engineering, 1-2 lines): In your first 90 days you will ship a production iteration of [feature], own its monitoring, and work closely with teammates to demonstrate measurable improvement. Wet check progress at 30/60/90 with examples and a short demo.

Offer sentence (Product, 1-2 lines): In your first 90 days you will define and ship an MVP of [feature], run initial user research, and set measurable criteria for success. Wet review outcomes at 30/60/90 to align on next steps.
```

rahul (Recruiter): Perfect. One more ask  a 3-bullet 'what to bring to the 30/60/90' that we can add to invites.

lee (Eng Manager): Throw these in:
- 'Bring one example of work (PR/spec/demo) to discuss.'
- 'Bring questions about team processes and any blockers.'
- 'Bring ideas for one small improvement you could lead next quarter.'

olivia (People Ops): This is great  concise and usable. I'll publish these three pieces to the hiring playbook: (1) Offer sentences, (2) 90-day manager checklist, (3) Self-review micro-prompts, plus the invite prep bullets. Thanks folks!

sam (Software Eng): If you want variants by seniority (junior vs senior), ping me and I can write a few leveled lines.

nina (Product): Ditto for PM levels. Small tweak: make sure offer language doesn't promise raises/promotions  keep focused on 'outcomes/expectations'.

olivia (People Ops): Noted. I'll keep it outcome-focused only. Finalizing and adding to the offer template now :tada:
